result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations with contour integrals of f(x+z) and integrals of the form \int e^{-y}(1+y/(2\alpha z))^{\alpha^2/2\pi i-1/2}dy, apparently toward asymptotic (saddle-point) expansions related to the Riemann–Siegel formula, with Gamma-function (\Pi) series coefficients.
result.transcription:
$\int f(x+z)\, z^{-3n-1} \partial z \; \frac{\Pi 3n!}{n!\, 6^n 2\pi i^n\, \alpha^n}$
$\int_0^\infty e^{-x} x^{3n} \partial x$
$\frac{1}{2\pi i}\int f(x+z) \int_0^\infty e^{-x - \frac{1}{\alpha}\left(\frac{x}{z}\right)^3 \frac{1}{6\pi i}} \partial x \frac{\partial z}{z}$ [-$+ \frac{1}{2\pi i}\int f(x+z) \int_0^\infty e^{-x - \frac{1}{\alpha}\left(\frac{x}{z}\right)^3\frac{1}{6\pi i}} \partial x \; \frac{x^5}{z^5\, \alpha^2 \pi i\, 2^4 \cdot 5}$-]
$\frac{1}{2\pi i}\int f(x+z)\, z^{-3n+3} \partial z \; \frac{\Pi(3n-4)!\,(3n-1)}{(n-2)!\, 6^{n-2}\, 2^{3n-2}\cdot 5\, (\pi i)^{n-1}\, \alpha^{n-2}}$
$\log\left(1+\frac{y}{\alpha}\right) = \frac{y}{\alpha} - \frac{1}{2}\frac{y^2}{\alpha^2} + \frac{1}{3}\frac{y^3}{\alpha^3}$
$\int \eta\; e^{-\frac{\alpha y}{2\pi i} + \frac{y^2}{4\pi i}}\left(1+\frac{y}{\alpha}\right)^{\frac{\alpha^2}{2\pi i}-\frac{1}{2}} \partial y$
$\Sigma a_n y^n$
$e^{2\pi i z z} f(x+z) = \int \eta\, e^{2zy} \partial y \qquad \int y^n \eta\, \partial y = \frac{b_n \Pi n}{2^n} \qquad \Sigma a_n b_n \frac{\Pi(n)}{2^n}$
$\Sigma b_n z^n$
$\int_0^\infty e^{-\frac{\alpha y}{2z\, 2\pi i} + \left(\frac{y}{2z}\right)^2\frac{1}{4\pi i}}\left(1+\frac{y}{2z\,\alpha}\right)^{\frac{\alpha^2}{2\pi i}-\frac{1}{2}} \partial y = \Sigma\, \Pi n\, a_n \frac{1}{(2z)^n}$
$\frac{1}{2\pi i}\int f(x+z)\, e^{2\pi i z z} \frac{\partial z}{z} \int_0^\infty e^{-y - \frac{\alpha}{2z}\frac{y}{2\pi i} + \left(\frac{y}{2z}\right)^2 \frac{1}{4\pi i}} \left(1+\frac{y}{2\alpha z}\right)^{\frac{\alpha^2}{2\pi i}-\frac{1}{2}} \partial y$
$e^{\frac{1}{4\pi i}\left(\frac{y}{2z} - \alpha - 4z\pi i\right)^2}$

methods.what: Representation of e^{2\pi i z^2}f(x+z) as a Laplace-type integral and term-by-term moment expansion
methods.quote: $e^{2\pi i z z} f(x+z) = \int \eta\, e^{2zy} \partial y \qquad \int y^n \eta\, \partial y = \frac{b_n \Pi n}{2^n} \qquad \Sigma a_n b_n \frac{\Pi(n)}{2^n}$

methods.what: Asymptotic series in 1/(2z) from expanding the integrand in powers of y
methods.quote: $\int_0^\infty e^{-\frac{\alpha y}{2z\, 2\pi i} + \left(\frac{y}{2z}\right)^2\frac{1}{4\pi i}}\left(1+\frac{y}{2z\,\alpha}\right)^{\frac{\alpha^2}{2\pi i}-\frac{1}{2}} \partial y = \Sigma\, \Pi n\, a_n \frac{1}{(2z)^n}$

methods.what: Completing the square in the exponent
Binomial expansion of (1+t/x)^\alpha with Gaussian integral giving Gamma-ratio coefficients (hypergeometric/Riemann P-function form)
Shift of integration variable y -> y-(\alpha+4z\pi i) to rewrite the integral
methods.quote: $e^{2\pi i z z - \frac{(\alpha+4\pi i z)^2}{4\pi i}} \int_{-(\alpha+4z\pi i)}^{\infty} e^{\frac{yy}{4\pi i}} (\alpha + 4\pi i z + 1 + y)^{\frac{\alpha^2}{2\pi i}-\frac{1}{2}} \partial y$
